title: Every .sufr fixture is read by a test and reproduced by mk_test_files.py
body: Batch 2 of sufr-25f57e. create_bytes_match_fixtures covers 13 of 16 fixtures in data/expected. 1d.sufr is version 4 and unreadable, 1m.sufr fails to open, 1s.sufr has no reader: each is covered or deleted. mk_test_files.py passes --write-lcp so a regeneration reproduces the committed bytes (sufr-c9b319). A fixture built with -m so the LCP under -m is pinned by bytes. The decision on the 12 create_* tests is on the parent.
